bibliographic.title: The Kingdom Ends Here
bibliographic.author: Frankiestan
bibliographic.description:
The kingdom will end today.
Seven hundred years ago, a woman cursed the first king and promised the kingdom would end. Today, the sky has changed, the bells are ringing wrong, and the old story no longer feels like a story.
You are the keeper of the Royal Grand Library. Before you leave the city with your friend, you have a few minutes among the books to find out what really happened.

A timed text-based exploration game about archives, history, blame, and the things a kingdom chooses to remember.

Taking notes is strongly recommended.
